title: Rotating Habitats
description: Spin a cylinder and its floor presses on your feet as gravity does: a = ω²r. Make it big and it can spin slowly enough that turning your head does not make you sick (under 2 turns a minute); but the hoop stress in its hull, ρω²r², grows with the square of its size, and that sets the largest you can build. O'Neill's cylinders were eight kilometres across. Unlocks the O'Neill Cylinder.

puzzle.goal: A habitat of radius r spins at angular speed ω. Write the apparent gravity a on its floor.
puzzle.name: Spin gravity
puzzle.ask: Find a in m/s² for r = @{r} m spinning at ω = @{w} rad/s.
puzzle.method: The floor must push you round the circle: the centripetal acceleration v²/r = ω²r.
